name: Retro Vintage
description: Nostalgic 70s-80s inspired aesthetic with warm tones and analog feel

color_palette.description: Warm earthy tones, sepia-inspired, muted saturations

dos: Use aged paper or film effects
donts: Avoid bright neon or digital colors
prompt_template: Create a {subject} in a retro vintage style. Use warm earthy color palette with tans (#D4A574, #CD853F), browns (#8B7355), and accent reds (#DC143C, #FF6347) on cream backgrounds (#FFF8DC). Design should be flat with retro perspective effects, grainy paper texture with halftone patterns, medium detail level with vintage ornamental elements. Composition should be symmetrical and badge-like with framed elements. Style: nostalgic, warm, authentic, timeless. Include vintage typography (serif, script fonts), retro badges and ribbons, ornamental borders. DO: add grain texture, use muted warm colors, symmetrical layout, aged paper effects. DON'T: use modern flat elements, bright neon colors, clean sans-serif fonts, glossy surfaces, futuristic elements.
